description: The Environment model omits `uuid`. Coolify's Environment model has a uuid (app/Models/Environment.php $fillable), the API returns it from GET /projects/{uuid}/{environment} and GET /projects/{uuid}/environments (ProjectController::environment_details, get_environments serialize the model), and create/update return it. Evidence: coollabsio/coolify main @ 5c987814 (2026-11-24).
